title: Add multicast support for xDrip
symptom: Users have difficulty configuring static IP addresses for wixel receivers, and data transmission via cloud can be slow, especially for remote snoozing and normal bg data. The issue proposes adding multicast support to improve reliability and speed.
evidence_quote: I'm not sure use of multicast is going to be practical due to the way android handles multicast power saving etc. As far as I understand it, a multicast lock is required which causes battery drain and isn't suitable for background operation as a receiver.
